content_units: 90-Minute Road Trip Playlist

Upbeat, clean, and family-safe for two adults plus a 10-year-old, with mostly pop/rock from 1995-2020. This sequence opens fast, eases into a lighter middle stretch, then finishes with big sing-along energy.
Sequenced Track List
Artist   Song   Year   Why it fits
1   Walk the Moon   Shut Up and Dance   2014   Immediate energy and easy chorus
2   Smash Mouth   All Star   1999   Kid-friendly, playful, classic sing-along
3   Kelly Clarkson   Since U Been Gone   2004   Big pop-rock hook without slowing momentum
4   Jonas Brothers   Sucker   2019   Bright, modern, catchy
5   Katrina and the Waves   Walking on Sunshine   1985   Classic sing-along lift for the whole car
6   American Authors   Best Day of My Life   2013   Positive, road-trip-ready feel
7   Owl City & Carly Rae Jepsen   Good Time   2012   Light, happy midpoint transition
8   Jack Johnson   Upside Down   2006   Softer, sunny breather for the middle
9   Natasha Bedingfield   Pocketful of Sunshine   2008   Warm, easygoing reset
10   Colbie Caillat   Brighter Than the Sun   2011   Keeps the dip gentle, not sleepy
11   The B-52's   Love Shack   1989   Fun family sing-along to start the climb back up
12   The Killers   Mr. Brightside   2003   Familiar, driving beat, huge chorus
13   OneRepublic   Counting Stars   2013   Strong late-playlist momentum
14   Bon Jovi   It's My Life   2000   Arena-sized sing-along classic
15   P!nk   Raise Your Glass   2010   Loud, fun, celebratory finish run
16   Queen   Don't Stop Me Now   1978   Peak-energy classic everyone can shout along to
17   Justin Timberlake   Can't Stop the Feeling!   2016   Keeps spirits high near the end
18   Journey   Any Way You Want It   1980   Big, triumphant road-trip closer
Flow and Family Fit
-   Starts energetic:   Tracks 1-6 hit quickly with recognizable hooks and driving rhythm.
-   Middle dip:   Tracks 7-10 soften the intensity without becoming slow or sad.
-   Ends strong:   Tracks 11-18 build into a high-energy sing-along finale.
-   Sing-along classics included:     All Star  ,   Walking on Sunshine  ,   It's My Life  ,   Don't Stop Me Now  , plus   Love Shack   and   Any Way You Want It  .
-   Constraint check:   No breakup ballad mood, no intentionally explicit picks, and the core leans pop/rock from 1995-2020.
